misprints.note: An iota subscript is clearly printed under the η in 'τύρσεις ἐπῇσαν'.
The scan clearly shows ρ for γ in the Hake entry ('försedd m. h.').
The genitive ending is printed as just 'χος'. This may be a deliberate abbreviation, so it was kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The first τ of θάλατταν has no crossbar on the scan, so it looks like ι ('θάλαιταν'). I read it as broken type and wrote θάλατταν. It could also be a wrong letter set by the printer.
The accent on τί is small and could be grave rather than acute. I wrote it as acute, matching 'ἔστι τί τινι' earlier in the same strip.
